message: 今そこにある壊滅の危機!?

name: Misa
message: 「Ugh, did I drink too much tea...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah. Misa--」

name: Synn
message: 「Hello--」

name: Synn
message: 「--Wait, huh... She left.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Th-This is terrible. I-I have to hide my wings quickly...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hello, Lolotte.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek!!」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hold on, Lolotte!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, you didn't have to run away...」

name: Synn
message: 「And so, that's what happened!」
I finally got to experience real school life.
Just when I thought I was about to enjoy my youth to the fullest, getting this harsh treatment is just too cruel.
At this rate, instead of a sparkling youth, it's just going to be tense and awkward.
I just want to get along happily and harmoniously with the girls.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, getting avoided like that. You poor thing.」

name: Ria
message: 「I don't think it's really like that, though~」

name: Synn
message: 「We're fellow Student Council members, so I just want us to get a little closer.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... And then you plan to control them body and soul, eventually making them your obedient slaves! As expected of Master Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not it at all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Getting close is impossible, impossible, impossible. Officially impossible.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Misa hates your guts, and Lolo-chan doesn't seem interested in that kind of thing.」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean by 'that kind of thing'...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hoping to make one of them your girlfriend if you get the chance, maybe?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-Not that kind of close! I mean as friends!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Naive. Way too naive. So naive it's like pouring oyster sauce all over pudding!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I mean, just because you're fellow Student Council members doesn't mean you're gonna fall head over heels right away, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Head over heels!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-Th-That's not what I'm talking about!\s01」

name: Ria
message: 「What about you, Nanaka-chan?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「M-Me!? I... well...」

name: Ria
message: 「You're a girl too, so surely you have one or two people you like, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I don't think anyone has two...」

name: Paqy
message: 「As long as you've got cake, that's all that matters to you, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What did you say!?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not cake, it's sweets, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Close! But wrong!」

name: Ria
message: 「If you want, I could give you some advice?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I don't need anything like that!!」

name: Ria
message: 「I see~ So you do have someone you like, Nanaka-chan.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What about you, Senpai!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh, me?」

name: Synn
message: 「S-S-Senpai's crush!?」

name: Ria
message: 「You don't have to squeak like that.\s02」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn... what's with that reaction?」

name: Synn
message: 「I was just a little surprised, that's all!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You didn't react at all when it was about me!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugyaaaa~~」

name: Ria
message: 「The person I like? Hmmm. Well...」
Did Ria-senpai just look over here?
And she took a moment to think!

name: Ria
message: 「It's... a... se-cret!\s04」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What are you looking so disappointed for?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaargh, give me a break already!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, you didn't ask Ria-senpai to be an advisor just to get her attention, did you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-Gah!? Th-Th-Th-There's no way I'd do that, alright?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Suspicious...」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone agreed to it back then, so it wasn't just my decision!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I guess that's true.」

name: Synn
message: 「*Cough, cough*...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, it bothers me that she was looking in your direction.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why do you even care so much, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I just care, alright?! I can't help it!」
Talk about an annoying, illogical outburst.

name: Paqy
message: 「I see... Is that how it is? I knew it, Ria-chan... about me...」
The clingy little creature attached to my arm began to tremble.

name: Paqy
message: 「Gazing at me with such passionate eyes... She's totally into me! Yaaaaay!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, I see.」
Nanaka claps her hands together as if everything just clicked.

name: Ria
message: 「Tee-hee. Who knows, maybe it really is Paa-chan.」

name: Synn
message: 「P-Paa-chan?」

name: Ria
message: 「In that case, what are you going to do, Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!? W-W-W-Why are you asking me!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, asking Nanaka-chan wouldn't be much help, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Please don't. If you're going to ask someone, ask the Vice President.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, please, don't do that either.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ooooh! Ooooh! So much LOVE! My gorgeous Ria-chwaaann!」

name: Ria
message: 「That's enough of that, no-no~」
Hands on her hips, leaning forward with her bottom sticking out.
In a 'Naughty boy!' pose, Ria-senpai flicked Paqy right on his forehead with her slender, delicate index finger.

name: Paqy
message: 「Uhyah! Ah, aaah, AAAAAHHH!」
My eyes were glued to her breasts dangling downward--wait,
Bad, bad!

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugh, shut up, you noisy panda.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, what were we talking about again?」

name: Synn
message: 「We were talking about getting along with everyone...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You just never learn, do you? Girlfriend, girlfriend, girlfriend, girlfriend, AHHH!」

name: Synn
message: 「I told you, drop it already!」

name: Ria
message: 「Mhm, mhm. Getting along with everyone is a wonderful thing, you know?\s05」

name: Synn
message: 「Exactly, exactly. If we don't, even the Student Council won't be any fun.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh, what? You mean you don't actually want a girlfriend?」

name: Synn
message: 「I've been saying that from the very beginning...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I get it, I get it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ouch, ouch!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Honestly. This guy can't speak clearly if he's got even an ounce of impure thoughts in his head.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yup. That's why I poked him a little. Just to make sure he doesn't get any funny ideas.」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you planning to write a thesis on me and present it at an academic conference or something, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「As if. At best, she could maybe make an picture diary out of you.」

name: Ria
message: 「An picture diary, huh~? That sounds kind of fun♪」

name: Synn
message: 「*Sigh*\s10 Whatever it is, I just want an opportunity to get along with everyone.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright, alright! How about I take a machine gun and turn those two into Swiss cheese, and Synn puts his life on the line to save them?」

name: Ria
message: 「If you do that, you won't be able to get along with them either, Nanaka-chan.」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, machine guns are way too expensive! We'd have to settle for rolling pins at best.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Rolling pins are dangerous. It'd be awful if someone got hurt.」
And so, the idea was rejected.

name: Ria
message: 「It's pretty classic, but how about everyone introduces themselves?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright! Let's start with Senpai first!」

name: Ria
message: 「Okay, hello there. I'm Ria Kujou. My hobby is drawing. My favorite food is traditional Japanese sweets.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, taking notes...」

name: Paqy
message: 「What are your three sizes?」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh?」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's your bra cup size!?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-W-Wait a minute, Paqy!」

name: Ria
message: 「Th-That's... a little... D-Do I really... have to say it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmph!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Mmph!」
A chop to the head bends the plushie into a U-shape.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright, next!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nice to meet you, I'm Synn Sakura. My hobbies are DIY and gardening.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's amazing!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Dee-eye-why?」

name: Paqy
message: 「It means DIY, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「My favorite food is beefsteak.」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, is that so~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, no! What a total lie! That's not a hobby, that's just a lifestyle habit. It's just your daily routine, isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm telling you, it's necessary for survival.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're trying to act cool using fancy terms, but you're really just repairing roof leaks and doing farm work.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「For your information, that's not a hobby. And besides, you've never even eaten beefsteak before!」

name: Synn
message: 「Can't I at least dream about eating beefsteak...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You have to introduce yourself honestly. Got it?」

name: Synn
message: 「But it's the truth...」

name: Ria
message: 「Now then, please bring us home.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm Nanaka Yuugiri. My hobby is going around trying different sweets. My favorite food is sweets!\s05」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone knows that already.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then what am I supposed to say?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Like how you can turn wasabi into 18-karat gold, or make a fortune turning soba water into petroleum.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「As if I could do that!」

name: Ria
message: 「I might be a little bad with spicy wasabi...\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「If you don't like spicy food, a tube that's been opened for a while or room-temperature wasabi packets are pretty good.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That kind of wasabi is sacrilege!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmm. It kind of lacks entertainment value.」

name: Synn
message: 「I think it's fun learning all sorts of things about people, though.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hearing about you isn't fun at all!」

name: Synn
message: 「Not for you, Nanaka. But you never know about Everyone else.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, that's true. But cheap penny-pinching stories kill the mood, so they're banned.」

name: Synn
message: 「Mmmm... Don't reveal your trump card right off the bat.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Ria-chan. Sorry I've been leaving all these absurdity-filled moments alone until now, but shouldn't we stop them soon?」

name: Ria
message: 「Nah. They're having a fun time lively together like this, so isn't it fine?」

name: Synn
message: 「Having a fun time lively together...」
That's it!

name: Synn
message: 「Hey. How about we all have a lively time together?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If we're getting lively, then it's time for a festival!」
Nanaka rolled up her sleeves in excitement.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Where were the drums again? We gotta get fireworks ready, too. Oh, and festival stalls!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, that's impossible.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, right. We're in the middle of autumn right now.」

name: Ria
message: 「Even in autumn, there are areas that hold harvest festivals and stuff.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then we're good to go!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not a seasonal issue...\s02」

name: Paqy
message: 「If a festival's out, let's throw a par-ty to praise and worship Ria-chan!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A party?」

name: Paqy
message: 「An evening of chat and bashfulness spent with Ria-chan. A standing buffet dinner par-ty at a luxury hotel!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A party, huh? Hey, Mr. P, you sure say some stylish stuff!」

name: Paqy
message: 「So with Ria-chan--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gyaaaahhhhh~~!」

name: Ria
message: 「Paa-chan. You can't interfere~\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Then a welcome party it is!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Welcoming who, exactly?」

name: Synn
message: 「Me?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What about me?!」

name: Ria
message: 「What about Misa-chan and Lolotte-chan?」

name: Synn
message: 「A~lright! Everyone's a guest!」

name: Ria
message: 「Um... so, does that mean I should welcome everyone?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no. We were the ones who welcomed you into the Student Council, Senpai, so... wait, what?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Easy now, calm down.」

name: Ria
message: 「Mmm... If you put it that way, maybe instead of a welcome party, it should be... a social gathering?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ooh.」

name: Synn
message: 「That sounds great!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hello, everyone.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hello~」

name: Synn
message: 「It's sudden, but we're having a meeting.」

name: Misa
message: 「What's with you all of a sudden?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now, now, take a seat, take a seat.」
Everyone took their respective seats.

name: Synn
message: 「I now call the second Student Council meeting to order.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gather round, folks! Here is the long-awaited agenda item!」

name: Misa
message: 「Wait just a minute!!」

name: Misa
message: 「A social gathering?! What on earth are you talking about? I haven't heard a thing about this!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's why we're having a meeting about it...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Um, what exactly is a social gathering?」

name: Ria
message: 「It's a party where everyone hangs out and has fun.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wow! That sounds like so much fun!」

name: Synn
message: 「Any objections? Go ahead.」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes! I object most strongly!」

name: Misa
message: 「First of all, I'd like you to thoroughly explain the intention, purpose, and prospects of this plan. Not to mention the drawbacks and issues that will arise from such actions.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, right, of course. I need to explain everything properly from step one.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn said it's because Misa and Rolo-chan seem to hate him, so he wants to get on friendly terms with you guys.」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaargh, why do you have to say it so directly?! You could've at least sugarcoated it a little, wrapped it up gently!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I don't particularly hate you, Mr. President ♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? *thump*」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That doesn't mean I like you either, though \s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... *collapse*」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Saying that with a bright smile makes it all the more brutal.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「For the record, as of now, our relationship is completely average.」

name: Ria
message: 「Well then, you'll just have to do your best from here on out.」

name: Synn
message: 「Do my best with what, exactly?! \s01」

name: Misa
message: 「So that's why you want a get-together? What an impure motive... \s10」

name: Ria
message: 「Really~? I've always wanted to get closer to everyone whenever there's a chance, though.」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh, w-well... Sister. I'm... not emotionally prepared yet... Ah, but to let this opportunity slip away--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Misa withdraws her objection.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hold on just a minute!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Why not? Let's all have fun together!」

name: Misa
message: 「You can't just look at the short-term benefits, can you? When and where will this take place, and what are we actually going to do?」

name: Misa
message: 「I cannot approve a plan brought forward without giving those things any thought!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Misa is completely right.」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, exactly. So long as you understand.」

name: Synn
message: 「How about this coming Saturday after school?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No objections!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I had plans to go out on Saturday, but if it is Student Council business, it cannot be helped. I shall cancel them.」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, umm...」

name: Ria
message: 「Misa-chan, are you busy?」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, no. It's not that, but...」

name: Ria
message: 「Then it's settled! Of course, Saturday works for me too.\s05」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright, Saturday it is!」

name: Synn
message: 「Next is the location. Let's all decide together. Where do you think would be good?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is here no good?」

name: Ria
message: 「Even if it's part of Student Council activities, it's not really a place we should use for recreation.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How terribly inconvenient.」

name: Synn
message: 「A public community center is pretty cheap. Like 150 yen for two hours. Ah, Japanese-style rooms are a bit more expensive, so let's pass on those.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We can't make a racket in a place like that!」

name: Misa
message: 「There's no need to make a racket in the first place.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Were you even listening? It's a party, a party! It's bound to be wild and crazy!」

name: Misa
message: 「Not necessarily. I figured it would be dancing, light conversation, dining, and elegantly enjoying music...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Indeed. But those are boring. The dresses are heavy and hard to move in, and they do not even let us drink the alcohol despite it being right there.」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I see...」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, yeah. It's usually mostly adults, so you can't really relate, plus ballroom dancing... it's pretty exhausting.」

name: Misa
message: 「R-Right? Exactly!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nghhh... you darn bourgeoisie...!」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't think we need to do anything elegant. After all, we're just a Student Council.」

name: Misa
message: 「Though she's certainly \{no ordinary person|\s12\s12\s12}...」

name: Ria
message: 「If we're all doing it together, it'd be great if we could just keep it casual, relaxed, and fun.\s05」

name: Paqy
message: 「Man, everything Ria-chan says comes with so much weight!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, whatever, fine. Let's do it at Synn's place.」

name: Synn
message: 「My place?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You've got plenty of empty rooms. Five people make enough noise to party, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Doing that would be a nuisance to the neighbors!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're the manager and the only resident anyway, aren't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Guh, she knows everything. That's childhood friends for you--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How about it, Misa? Did I miss anything?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph. Something decided on the spot like this will never go smoothly.」

name: Synn
message: 「Now, now. Regardless of what's said, we're the ones actually doing it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And that includes you too, Madam Vice President, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「What are you talking about?! Since I'm involved, failure is not an option!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's it, that's it! That's the spirit, Madam Vice President!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha...\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, let's take a vote. All those in favor, please state your position.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, place your bets, place your bets!」

name: Everyone
message: 「In favor!」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you against it, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「I... can't find a reason to oppose it that strongly this time...」

name: Misa
message: 「I-In favor.」

name: Synn
message: 「By unanimous consent, the motion is passed!」

name: Ria
message: 「Congratulations, Synn-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, it's really thanks to everyone.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mmm, I can't wait for Saturday!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I am really looking forward to it. Well then, good job today, everyone~\s07」

name: Misa
message: 「Wait, wait! What do you think you're doing trying to leave? We haven't finished today's work yet.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh? Was there something left to do?」

name: Misa
message: 「I told you earlier, the shelves got too cramped, so we need to move the meeting logs up to two years ago into the archives.」
Misa stood with her arms crossed in front of a mountain of documents pushed into a corner of the room.
It was one of those tasks I'd wanted to pretend didn't exist ever since taking over.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, now that you mention it, we kept putting that off because it was a pain, didn't we?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, there's nothing to fear if we do it together. Let's get it over with quickly.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Let's do this!」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, all done! Great job, everyone!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Good job!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Party, party~♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I am super excited!\s05」

name: Misa
message: 「No way... That looked like way too much work to finish in a day, so how did we finish so fast?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha, I wish it were always like this.\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks to that, we're basically done with the odd jobs. Now the new Student Council can finally start its real activities.」

name: Misa
message: 「I wonder what kind of face Director Helena would make if she heard that our first step is a get-together party.」

name: Helena
message: 「A face like this.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!」

name: Helena
message: 「Yoo-hoo, Student Council folks.」

name: Synn
message: 「Your face is too close! Way too close!」
I mean, I can literally feel your warm breath on me!

name: Helena
message: 「What's this? Want me to get closer? My, what a bad boy.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nobody said anything like that!」

name: Helena
message: 「Ah... But if I get any closer, I might kiss you.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Kiss?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wh-a-at?!\s08」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I-In public, no less!」

name: Ria
message: 「Big sis!」

name: Synn
message: 「GAAAAH!」
I grabbed her shoulders firmly and pushed her away. She was surprisingly light.

name: Ria
message: 「Gosh! Please stop it!」
Ria-senpai stepped in between us. Whew.

name: Helena
message: 「Well, he just has a face that makes you want to tease him. Oh, don't tell me you got excited?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-What?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Stop lying through your teeth! You always say things like 'I prefer mature older men\s04'!」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, come on, don't spoil my fun!」
Was she just teasing me?! She might be an adult woman, but honestly, this person...

name: Lolotte
message: 「Madam Chairwoman. You really make the funniest faces.」

name: Helena
message: 「My, thank you. But if you talk too much, I might just expel you.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eeeek!」
And so, Helena-san swung her power around today like a home run king.

name: Helena
message: 「Tee-hee. Oh dear, I'm just joking. As if I had that kind of authority.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Phew...」

name: Helena
message: 「All I can do is shut down the entire academy in a fit of rage!」

name: Misa
message: 「P-Please don't!」

name: Paqy
message: 「I seriously question why someone like her is the chairwoman.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Elm!」

name: Helena
message: 「What is it, Paqy-chan?」

name: Paqy
message: 「...Or so Lord Synn said.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-W-Wait, Paqy! Don't pin that on me!」

name: Helena
message: 「This year's Student Council president has quite a fiery spirit. Mhm, I like it.」

name: Ria
message: 「Geez! Stop tickling me out of nowhere!」
You really don't look like you're being tickled at all, though!

name: Helena
message: 「A social gathering sounds great. It's the perfect plan to deepen the bond among officers.」

name: Misa
message: 「Is this really okay...?」

name: Helena
message: 「As long as you get your work done, nobody has any right to complain, do they?」

name: Helena
message: 「Let's see. From what I can tell... the thing you guys in the Student Council lack the most is--」

name: Helena
message: 「That's right, teamwork!」

name: Helena
message: 「Now, everyone, let's hold hands.」

name: Misa
message: 「Why do we have to do that...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If you defy her, there's no telling what she'll do to you later.」
Trembling in fear, everyone forms a circle and holds hands.
Lolotte's small, warm hand rested lightly in the palm of mine.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Your hands are cool and feel nice, Mr. President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? R-Really?」
A little nervous.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is it true that people with cold hands have cold hearts, too?」
It's hard to defend myself by saying it's usually the opposite.

name: Nanaka
message: 「And as usual, I get zero reaction from you.」

name: Synn
message: 「I mean, we're childhood friends. Holding hands is no big deal.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, true. Like when we went hiking together, or danced folk dances, or when I saved you when you were about to drown in the sea.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hold on a second. When we went hiking, we raced each other, so we didn't hold hands.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, right.」

name: Synn
message: 「During the folk dance, the boombox broke right before it got to Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah! That was so weird~」

name: Synn
message: 「And we didn't drown in the sea in the first place.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Neither of us can swim that well, after all. We were just clam digging in the shallows, weren't we?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, wait...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What is this strange feeling?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So, this is the first time you two have held hands, then.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「THAT'S NOT TRUE... PROBABLY.」

name: Synn
message: 「I WANT TO BELIEVE THAT.」

name: Helena
message: 「Is everyone holding hands tightly? Make it tight, now! Tight! Is anyone left out?」

name: Ria
message: 「Big sister...」

name: Helena
message: 「What is it?」

name: Ria
message: 「That's the wrong place to grab!」

name: Helena
message: 「Listen closely, Ria. I am clutching your hot, passionately burning heart.」

name: Helena
message: 「I just want to convey my enthusiasm to everyone like this, as we work hard together in the Student Council from now on. That's all there is to it.」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I had no idea...」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai, she's totally fooling you.\s01」

name: Helena
message: 「Synn-chan, do you want to touch it too?」

name: Synn
message: 「Eeeh?!」

name: Ria
message: 「N-No, you can't!」
And so, a circle was formed that looked like nothing other than an attempt to summon a UFO from the sky.

name: Helena
message: 「Alright! Preparations are complete. Now finish it up at the social gathering.」
That was more exhausting than the work earlier.

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, by the way. You can't use the Student Council budget for the get-together, okay?\s04」

name: Helena
message: 「Well then, I pray for the success of your get-together.」
